what: The declared matched-basis ladder: the matched-truncation instrument's same state space, the same twelve english and eleven latin member roster, the same plants and floors, and the same six relabeling-invariant summaries over the same mark-excluded state space (1296 ordered types), re-priced with the truncation basis swept at declared rungs: the real's own mass anchor rung first (the matched-truncation artifact's own basis, band streams cut to the real's counted pair mass), then 75, 50 and 25 percent rungs of it, every band's closed ranges re-priced at each rung and every movement recorded against the anchor rung's bands both ways. The declared truthful question: does any rung's matched band admit the real's mark-excluded profile inside on every declared invariant in every (file, language) cell, or do every rung's verdicts stand. No mapping is published; nothing here is a reading.

declared.boundary_rule: the word-boundary mark's row and column are excluded from every profile's state space on both sides exactly as the boundary-mark re-instrument declared: every profile is the mark-excluded block of its pair-count matrix, 1296 ordered types, the mark located in each matrix's own alphabet, and the standing alphabet-width disclosure carries unchanged (the IT real transcription ranks only 23 glyph types plus the mark, so 13 of its block's 36 glyph slots are empty by width alone on the real side while the simulated alphabets are saturated at 36 in every cell)
declared.ladder_rung_rule: the matched basis swept at declared rungs, recorded as design before any pricing: the anchor rung is the matched-truncation instrument's basis, the cell's real counted pair total + 1 tokens (ZL 218,416, GC 183,200, IT 220,532); the three declared rungs descend at floor(p x the anchor basis) tokens for p 0.75, 0.50 and 0.25 (ZL 163,812, 109,208 and 54,604; GC 137,400, 91,600 and 45,800; IT 165,399, 110,266 and 55,133); at every rung each of the roster's encodings re-runs its own frozen chain over the standing truncated reference's first rung tokens, a stream above the rung cut accordingly and a stream at or below it stays whole, and every cut row prices its rung basis - 1 pairs full width (the exact identity, matched length - 1); the declared truth about the arithmetic is the matched-truncation instrument's restated: a cut can move a band's closed ranges both ways, both verdict directions are open at every rung, and the artifact records each rung's movement counts against the anchor rung's bands; the real is priced once, unchanged across rungs
declared.roster_rule: the corpus-breadth roster stands unchanged: the same eight accepted corpus files, the same rejected candidates with their verbatim causes, the same sha256 records, the roster floor and the fetch verification are the corpus-breadth artifact's declared facts taken by reference, no corpus file is re-fetched, re-probed or re-hashed here, and the roster's streams replay through the standing declared processing with no new step

invariants.sorted_symbol_marginals: the 36 mark-excluded glyph marginals as a multiset, stored sorted descending as counts and shares, envelope-tested by sorted position over 36 positions
invariants.sorted_pair_multiset: the 1296 mark-excluded pair counts as a multiset, stored sorted descending as counts and shares, envelope-tested by sorted position
invariants.empty_type_count: the number of the block's mark-excluded pair types with zero counted occurrences, a scalar inside [min, max]
invariants.self_pair_share: the block's diagonal sum over the profile's glyph-pair total
invariants.top_k_shares: the share of the glyph-pair total carried by the k largest pair counts, at k 1, 10 and 50
invariants.pair_entropy: the natural entropy of the mark-excluded pair distribution in nats per counted glyph pair

declared.state_note: every profile here is the mark-excluded block of the same pair-count matrices the boundary-mark instrument priced, priced at its own stream's rung width: the real is priced once at its own kept-adjacent mass and is not re-cut anywhere (its profile is the matched-truncation artifact's real profile unchanged), so below the anchor rung the real's full-mass profile is compared against bands whose streams price the rung's descending mass and the ladder reads the bands' movements, not a mass match, at those rungs; every share-valued invariant normalises by its own glyph-pair total; the plaintext control's state is the 27 reference letters alone (729 types, no boundary mark) and takes no part in any envelope; the latin envelopes stay size-mixed at every rung by the roster's own declared construction; the IT cells are degenerate only at the anchor rung (their basis there equals the standing truncated length because the real transcription holds no unmapped events) and at the lower rungs their streams cut like every other cell's, so the IT cells' anchor facts equal their matched-truncation facts exactly and their lower rungs carry fresh descending facts
declared.machinery_rule: this instrument contains no assignment search anywhere: no candidate evaluation, no restarts, no sweep cap, no convergence flags; the standing budgets are not applicable and no machinery recording appears for that reason
declared.split_rule: no split applies: a profile uses every counted pair of its stream after the declared exclusion; the climb and score halves of the band instruments have no counterpart here
declared.seed_kinds: the standing encoding, plant and floor kinds replay at their frozen positions with their frozen selected draws exactly as every predecessor declared; each matched encoding runs its own frozen chain's declared draws over the rung's stream from draw 0 upward; no new seed is consumed and no draw selection is performed
declared.seed_sharing: the standing-basis facts replay through the declared chains and verify against the frozen matched-truncation artifact field for field under the gate, whose anchor-run band the anchor rung re-derives fresh; every rung's matched facts run the same seeds over the rung's streams from draw 0 upward; every block profile of every rung row is the declared block of its own replayed rung encoding
declared.rung_record_rule: per cell the artifact records the real record once (verified against the frozen matched-truncation real record) and four rungs in declared order (the anchor rung first, then 75, 50 and 25 percent), each rung carrying its basis, its cut counts, its member and plant matched records, its matched plaintext control, its envelope tests, its outside list and its verdict; every member row carries its standing-basis anchors beside its matched facts at every rung, and the floors, the standing plant width and the standing plaintext control are recorded once at the cell because they are rung-independent facts the gate verifies
declared.plants_rule: the plant encodings recorded at every rung like the band: each rung's rows carry the standing full width (the standing encoding's own, gate-anchored to the frozen corpus-breadth rows), their matched lengths min(plant length, rung), their matched totals (the same exact identity, matched length - 1) and their matched glyph-block profiles; the plants_at_source_identity boolean reports the standing widths at the standing lengths
declared.floors_rule: the 30 destroyed-adjacency floors recorded once at the cell, unchanged across the rungs: a floor's full width is the shuffled kept-adjacency structure's own pair count, the real's counted pair total, so nothing here re-cuts them and their glyph-block profiles replay under the gate; their declared role is the shuffled-structure control recorded beside every rung's verdict, not part of any envelope
declared.plaintext_rule: each cell records the standing truncated reference's own plaintext stream profile once and each rung's matched control re-cut to that rung beside it, both computed by the same formulas on the 27-type letter state, as the prose control beside the verdict; neither control takes part in any envelope
declared.verdict_rule: declared strict-all, unchanged, priced per rung: a rung-cell is shape-consistent-with-homophonic-encoding only when every declared invariant of the real's glyph-block profile sits inside the closed range of that rung's matched band's glyph-block profiles (the two vector summaries term by term inside the band's per-position envelope over 36 sorted positions, the scalar summaries inside [min, max] at the stored 6-decimal rounding); any outside invariant makes the rung-cell shape-outside-analogues, every outside entry is recorded with its band range so the miss is audited not summarized, and the declared question is asked over all 24 rung-cell verdicts together
declared.closure_rule: no scalar margin is formed: this instrument's question is inside or outside per invariant per rung, and the recorded distances are the outside entries' band ranges themselves
declared.exclusion_rule: the family's declared exclusion format is not re-scoped by this artifact: it keys to the declared 36-slot class under the inherited add-one form exactly as the held-out screen declared it, so a search-free verdict is structure evidence and the band instruments' verdicts stand untouched by this artifact's numbers
declared.bridge_gate: before any rung is priced, the gate verified fresh in two stages: the matched-truncation instrument's gate exactly as that instrument declared it (the corpus-breadth instrument's 399 anchor fields and the 141 standing-row replay checks, 540 fields), then the anchor rung's six cells verified equal to the frozen matched-truncation artifact's six cells field for field: each anchor member row's matched block, each anchor plant row's matched block, each anchor matched plaintext control, each anchor basis with its cut counts, and each anchor envelope result, 20 checks per english cell and 19 per latin cell, 117 checks total, 657 fields compared; the three descended rungs carry no frozen counterpart and ride on the declared rung rule; any divergence aborts with nothing written
declared.models_rule: no score table is built or used: the instrument prices count structure only, so the standing add-one and leave-one-out tables play no part anywhere in this artifact
